quests.instruction: Which statement about frozen fruit is true?
quests.correctAnswer: It is handy because it is frozen soon after picking
options: It always has syrup and extra sugar added to it
It is handy because it is frozen soon after picking
It has lost all of its fiber and vitamins
quests.hint: Think about what freezing does.
quests.explanation: Frozen fruit is usually picked ripe and frozen soon after, so it is a handy way to enjoy fruit all year. Plain frozen fruit has no added sugar.
quests.funFact: Frozen berries and mango pieces are popular in smoothies.

quests.instruction: Which canned peach choice usually has less added sugar?
quests.correctAnswer: Peaches canned in water or their own juice
options: Peaches canned in water or their own juice
Peaches canned in thick, sweet syrup
All canned peaches have the same sugar
quests.hint: Look at what the fruit is packed in.
quests.explanation: Peaches canned in water or juice usually have less added sugar than peaches canned in syrup.
quests.funFact: Fruit canned in juice usually says so on the label.

quests.instruction: How is a smoothie made from whole fruit different from fruit juice?
quests.correctAnswer: Blending keeps the fiber, while juicing removes much of it
options: Blending keeps the fiber, while juicing removes much of it
Blending removes the fiber, while juicing keeps all of it
Blending and juicing both remove all of the fiber
quests.hint: Think about what stays in when the whole fruit is blended.
quests.explanation: A smoothie made from whole fruit keeps its fiber, while many juices have much of the fiber taken out.
quests.funFact: Smoothies can be thick because the fiber stays in.

quests.instruction: On a food label, how are the ingredients listed?
quests.correctAnswer: From the largest amount to the smallest
options: From the smallest amount to the largest
From the largest amount to the smallest
quests.hint: The first ingredient makes up the most.
quests.explanation: Ingredients are listed starting with the one there is the most of.
quests.funFact: If sugar is first on a fruit snack's list, there is more sugar than anything else.

quests.instruction: What does "added sugar" mean on a food label?
quests.correctAnswer: Sugar put in while the food was made
options: Sugar that grew inside the fruit
Sugar put in while the food was made
quests.hint: Think about what a food factory or kitchen adds.
quests.explanation: Added sugar is sugar that is put in during cooking or making, not the natural sugar already in the fruit.
quests.funFact: Plain fresh fruit has no added sugar.

quests.instruction: Strawberry jam or fresh strawberries: which usually has more added sugar?
quests.hint: Think about how jam is made.
quests.explanation: Jam is usually made by cooking fruit with added sugar, while fresh strawberries only have their natural sugar.
quests.funFact: Sugar also helps jam keep for a long time.

quests.instruction: Mango, papaya and cantaloupe get their orange color from which natural pigment?
quests.hint: Carrots have it too.
quests.explanation: Beta-carotene is a natural orange pigment found in many orange fruits and vegetables.
quests.funFact: Carrots get their orange color from beta-carotene as well.

quests.instruction: Blueberries and blackberries get their deep colors from what?
options: Food dye added at the shop
quests.hint: The color is made by the plant itself.
quests.explanation: Natural plant pigments called anthocyanins give many fruits their blue, purple and deep red colors.
quests.funFact: These pigments can shift color a little when they meet acid, like lemon juice.

quests.instruction: What natural substance makes green fruits and leaves green?
quests.hint: Plants use it to capture sunlight.
quests.explanation: Chlorophyll is the green substance plants use to capture sunlight.
quests.funFact: As some fruits ripen, their chlorophyll fades and other colors appear.

quests.instruction: Which fruit is unusual because it is rich in natural plant oils instead of mostly sugar and water?
quests.hint: Think of a creamy fruit that is not sweet.
quests.explanation: Avocado is rich in natural plant oils, which is why it feels creamy rather than sweet and watery.
quests.funFact: Avocado flesh is creamy because of its natural oils.

quests.instruction: Which part of a coconut is mostly water?
quests.hint: Think about what you can drink.
quests.explanation: Coconut water is mostly water with a little sugar and minerals. The white flesh is firmer and richer in plant fats.
quests.funFact: Coconut flesh has plant fats, which is why coconut milk is creamy.

quests.instruction: Which berry has many tiny seeds that add crunch and fiber?
quests.hint: Its seeds are small enough to eat.
quests.explanation: Raspberries have lots of tiny edible seeds that add crunch and fiber.
quests.funFact: Raspberries hold a lot of fiber for such a light fruit.

quests.instruction: Which is a typical single serving of fruit?
quests.hint: Think about what one person might eat as a snack.
quests.explanation: A small apple, a banana or a handful of grapes is a typical single portion of fruit.
quests.funFact: Portions look different for different fruits because fruits come in so many sizes.

quests.instruction: Which fruit is an easy-to-carry snack that gives quick energy before sports?
quests.hint: Think of a fruit that comes in its own wrapper and fits in a bag.
quests.explanation: A banana has natural sugars for energy and comes in its own peel, so it is easy to carry.
quests.funFact: Many runners and tennis players eat bananas during events.

quests.instruction: After eating sticky dried fruit, what helps your teeth?
quests.hint: Sticky foods can cling to teeth.
quests.explanation: Sticky dried fruit can cling to teeth, so a rinse with water or brushing helps keep your teeth clean.
quests.funFact: Water is a great helper after any sweet or sticky food.

quests.instruction: Which snack pairs fruit with another food to make a more filling snack?
quests.hint: Think about adding a different food group.
quests.explanation: Fruit with yogurt, cheese or nuts makes a more filling snack than fruit alone.
quests.funFact: Fruit and yogurt is a favorite breakfast in many countries.

quests.instruction: Instead of adding sugar to cereal, what can you add for sweetness?
quests.hint: Think about a fruit that is naturally sweet.
quests.explanation: Fruit adds natural sweetness, so you may not need extra sugar.
quests.funFact: Fruit also adds color and texture to breakfast bowls.

quests.instruction: Which drink is a good way to add flavor to water without adding sugar?
quests.correctAnswer: Water with a few citrus slices
options: Water with a spoon of sugar
Water with a few citrus slices
quests.hint: Think about fruit slices floating in a jug.
quests.explanation: A few slices of citrus fruit or berries give water a light fruity taste with no added sugar.
quests.funFact: Lemons, limes and mint are popular water flavorings around the world.

quests.instruction: Why can fruit help you feel full?
quests.hint: Think about what fruit is made of.
quests.explanation: Fiber and water add bulk, so fruit can help you feel full.
quests.funFact: Chewing fruit also takes time, which helps you notice when you are full.

quests.instruction: The natural sugars in fruit give your body what?
quests.hint: Think about why you can run and play.
quests.explanation: The natural sugars in fruit give your body energy to move, think and play.
quests.funFact: Natural sugars are one reason ripe fruit tastes so good.

quests.instruction: Lemon juice can sting a small cut on your finger. Why?
options: Lemon juice is always icy cold
Lemon juice is very thick and sticky
quests.hint: Think about why lemons taste so sour.
quests.explanation: The acid that makes lemons sour can sting small cuts, so keep lemon juice away from them.
quests.funFact: Citrus juice can sting eyes too, so wash your hands after squeezing.

quests.instruction: What is the name of a natural sugar found in fruit?
quests.hint: It ends in -ose, like many sugars.
quests.explanation: Fructose is a natural sugar found in fruit, honey and some vegetables.
quests.funFact: Fructose is one of the sweetest natural sugars.

quests.instruction: As a banana ripens, starch turns into what?
quests.hint: Think about why ripe bananas taste sweeter.
quests.explanation: Green bananas are starchy, and as they ripen the starch turns into sugar.
quests.funFact: Unripe bananas can feel chalky because of their starch.

quests.instruction: What natural fiber in fruit helps jam set into a soft gel?
quests.hint: Apples and citrus peels have plenty of it.
quests.explanation: Pectin is a natural fiber in fruit, and it helps jam set into a soft gel when it is cooked with sugar.
quests.funFact: Apples and citrus peels are especially rich in pectin.

quests.instruction: Which of these belongs to the fruit group on a food plate?
quests.hint: Think of the food groups on a plate.
quests.explanation: Mango belongs to the fruit group. Rice is a grain and cheese is dairy.
quests.funFact: Food groups help us remember to eat many kinds of foods.

quests.instruction: A tomato is a fruit to scientists, but cooks often treat it as a vegetable. Why?
quests.correctAnswer: Cooks sort foods by use, while scientists sort them by how they grow
options: Cooks sort foods by use, while scientists sort them by how they grow
Tomatoes turn into vegetables once they are cooked in a pan
Scientists and cooks sort foods in exactly the same way
quests.hint: There are two different ways to sort foods.
quests.explanation: Scientists group foods by how plants make them, while cooks group them by how they are used in meals, so a tomato can be both.
quests.funFact: In 1893, a court case about taxes in the United States called tomatoes vegetables.

quests.instruction: Which dried fruit is often sweetened because the fresh fruit is very tart?
quests.hint: Think about which of these fruits is not already very sweet.
quests.explanation: Fresh cranberries are very tart, so dried cranberries are usually sweetened. Dates and figs are naturally very sweet.
quests.funFact: Dried cranberries are often added to cereals and trail mixes.

quests.instruction: A friend says fruit is bad because it has sugar. What is a good reply?
quests.correctAnswer: Fruit has natural sugar plus fiber, water and vitamins
options: You are right, fruit should be avoided completely
Fruit has exactly the same things as candy
Fruit has natural sugar plus fiber, water and vitamins
quests.hint: Think about what else is in fruit besides sugar.
quests.explanation: Fruit has natural sugar, but also fiber, water and vitamins, so it is a very different food from sweets.
quests.funFact: Early humans gathered wild fruit long before farming began.

quests.instruction: Which habit helps you get the most from fruit?
quests.correctAnswer: Eating a mix of whole fruits through the week
options: Eating only one favorite fruit every single day
Eating a mix of whole fruits through the week
Eating fruit juice instead of any whole fruit
quests.hint: Think about variety.
quests.explanation: A mix of fruits gives a variety of vitamins, minerals, fibers and flavors.
quests.funFact: Trying one new fruit each week is a fun challenge.

quests.instruction: Which of these is a fruit choice with no added sugar?
quests.hint: Check which one is only fruit.
quests.explanation: Plain frozen berries are just fruit. Candy and syrup usually have added sugar.
quests.funFact: Many frozen berries are packed within hours of being picked.
